before.description: per-body declaration epoch (RUE-1133 probe branch merged with trunk, before the declaration base)

corpus: rue-scaling-bench synthetic single-file corpus: `bodies` reached bodies plus `decls` unrelated declarations plus main
note: Wall-clock timings on a shared 4-core container; treat the ratios, not the absolute milliseconds, as the result. Every sample retained below.

shape: The speedup grows with the declaration universe because the removed term is the O(bodies x declarations) epoch rebuild. Cold work remains O(bodies x declarations) with a smaller coefficient; it does not become flat.
against_rue_1133: RUE-1133 predicted a ~6.5x ceiling for a shared base against a 5.75x measured clone arm. The larger points land in that range.
not_measured_here: The value-audit protocol (benchmarks/value-audit/manifest.toml) has not been run for this change: it needs three role binaries, a historical baseline, and the paired median/MAD sampling policy on a quiet host. These points are a coefficient measurement, not a value-audit row.
